items.statement: QL-4620: quartzlane query latency roughly doubled after the tokenizer refactor.
items.verbatim_anchor: latency basically doubled right after the tokenizer refactor

items.statement: Profiling showed the quartzlane ngram splitter recompiling its pattern on every call.
items.verbatim_anchor: the ngram splitter recompiles its pattern on every single call

items.statement: The user indicated shipping a compiled-pattern cache as the fix for the quartzlane tokenizer.
items.verbatim_anchor: ship the compiled pattern cache, that is the fix

items.statement: The user indicated reverting the strategy interface added in the refactor.
items.verbatim_anchor: revert the strategy interface, it bought us nothing

items.statement: With the pattern cache, quartzlane p95 query latency fell from 210ms back to 96ms.
items.verbatim_anchor: p95 went from 210 down to 96 with the cache in place

items.statement: The user wants a perf gate in quartzlane CI that fails p95 regressions over ten percent.
items.verbatim_anchor: a perf gate in CI that fails anything ten percent over baseline

items.statement: The user felt embarrassed that the regression shipped in their own refactor.
items.verbatim_anchor: mildly embarrassing that my own refactor did this

items.statement: Casper Hale flagged the quartzlane latency regression first from his own install.
items.verbatim_anchor: Casper actually flagged it first from his install

items.statement: The quartzlane benchmark suite covers twelve query shapes.
items.verbatim_anchor: the bench suite covers twelve query shapes

items.statement: The user planned to cut quartzlane release 0.9.1 once the cache merges.
items.verbatim_anchor: cut zero nine one as soon as the cache merges

distractors.statement: The profiler UI theme annoyed the user.

courier at the door mid benchmark, one minute
